_what: Probe 3b -- HALF-WEIGHT READER. Registered entirely before any number exists: fit gate, earn rule, held-out bands and ship rule are all fixed here.
_motivation_from_measured_data: full-weight reader: fit +7/-1 R@3, -4 R@1; held-out +3/-0 R@3, -4 R@1. The rescue is real and lossless at set level; the head cost scales with the opinion's vote share. Halving the vote share is the single declared parameter, argued here BEFORE any half-weight number exists: two relevance graphs keep 4/5 of the vote mass, the reader holds 1/5.
_no_sweep: w=0.5 is the only value ever run. A sweep would be fitting the vote share.
implementation: third-list contribution in the RRF sum multiplied by 0.5 (algebraically identical to presenting the reader list at k_eff = 130); everything else identical to PREREGISTRATION-PICK.json
_ship_rule_rationale_written_before_data: at half weight the expected trade is +2-3 R@3 against -1-2 R@1; requiring R@3 >= 206 demands a REAL gain, requiring R@1 >= 158 caps the head cost at two cases.
